say:1:1064501001:0.text: At the center of the Bonn Grand Theater stage, the once-grand symphony orchestra has long since disbanded. Only its concertmaster Bartok remains, performing a classical piece alone.
say:1:1064501001:0.source_cn: 波恩大剧院舞台中央，昔日宏大的交响乐团早已解散，唯有乐...

say:3:1064501002:1.text: As the performance nears its end, he rises and bows to the few listeners remaining in the audience.
say:3:1064501002:1.source_cn: 演奏已过大半，他缓缓起身，向台下寥寥几位听众鞠躬示意。

say:4:1064501003:0.text: Thank you all for coming, especially in these troubled times.
say:4:1064501003:0.source_cn: 感谢各位，在这样动荡的时刻，仍愿意来到这里。

say:5:1064501004:0.text: The suite I'm about to play is a melody I've spent years searching for. It was composed by the legendary Celestial of music, <style="highlight">Sylphira</style>.
say:5:1064501004:0.source_cn: 接下来这套组曲，是我多年来一直追寻的旋律——它出自传说...

say:6:1064501005:0.text: I've spent half my life studying her work, yet I've only managed to capture a fraction of its elegance and grandeur.
say:6:1064501005:0.source_cn: 我穷尽半生研习，也只能触及其中些许高雅与庄严。

say:7:1064501006:0.text: Perhaps the divine resonance that can restore peace to the soul exists only when played by a Celestial, beyond the reach of mortals...
say:7:1064501006:0.source_cn: 那份令灵魂重归和谐的神韵，或许只存在于半神的演奏中，凡...

say:8:1064501007:0.text: Even so, whenever I hear this melody, I feel a profound sense of peace. I hope this music allows you to forget about the darkness hanging over the city.
say:8:1064501007:0.source_cn: 即便如此，每当这旋律响起，我都能感到内心变得无比安宁。...

say:10:1064501008:0.text: Bartok sits back down. The first notes drift through the theater, carrying an unwavering sense of order—like a steady light sweeping across a chaotic realm.
say:10:1064501008:0.source_cn: 巴托克重新落座，第一串音符流淌而出，带有一种不可动摇的...

say:11:1064501009:0.text: The few audience members gradually relax.
say:11:1064501009:0.source_cn: 台下寥寥几名听众慢慢放松了肩膀，连呼吸都变得轻缓。

say:12:1064501010:1.text: Suddenly, the theater doors burst open.
say:12:1064501010:1.source_cn: 这时，剧院大门被猛然推开！

say:15:1064501011:1.text:
Good evening, Mr. Bartok.
Have you reconsidered our offer to join the <style="highlight">Syndicate Orchestra</style>?
say:15:1064501011:1.source_cn: 巴托克先生，晚上好。\n加入<style=highli...

say:17:1064501013:0.text: Lira gives a signal to several accomplices next to him. They move toward the audience.
say:17:1064501013:0.source_cn: 利拉向身旁的几名同伙使了个眼色，后者快步走向听众席。

say:22:1064501015:0.text: Heh. If you really want to hear some music, go listen to the Syndicate Orchestra instead!
say:22:1064501015:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，要是你们实在想听演奏，就去我们黑金乐团！

say:23:1064501016:0.text: The audience members panic and flee. Within a few seconds, only Bartok and the intruders are left in the theater.
say:23:1064501016:0.source_cn: 听众们惊惶起身，转眼间，剧院只剩下巴托克与这群不速之客。

say:27:1064501017:0.text: Well now, Mr. Bartok. Now that the performance is over, we can finally talk business.
say:27:1064501017:0.source_cn: 呵呵，巴托克先生，您看，现在演奏结束了，我们可以谈谈了吧。

say:28:1064501018:1.text: I've told you countless times. I will never join your orchestra.
say:28:1064501018:1.source_cn: ……我已经重复过许多次，我绝不会加入你们的乐团。

say:29:1064501019:1.text: With your talent, playing in an empty theater like this is a tragic waste. How many people were out there just now? Five? Six?
say:29:1064501019:1.source_cn: 以您的才华，在这么冷清的场所演奏，着实是可惜。刚才台下...

say:30:1064501020:1.text: Most of the musicians in Bonn have already joined us. They're smart people.
say:30:1064501020:1.source_cn: 说真的，现在波恩城像样的音乐家，大多都已加入我们了，他...

say:31:1064501021:1.text: <style="highlight">The only reason they joined is because they've been seduced by your twisted music!</style>

say:32:1064501022:1.text: Those who listen to your music fly into rages over the smallest things. A father beat his own son just for saying he disliked your music!
say:32:1064501022:1.source_cn: 那些听过你们演奏的人，为一点小事就会拔刀相向。有个父亲...

say:33:1064501023:1.text: Music is meant to comfort the grieving and give courage to the fearful. But your music only robs people of reason and mercy.
say:33:1064501023:1.source_cn: 音乐本应让悲伤者重新呼吸，让恐惧者站稳脚跟。但你们想让...

say:34:1064501024:1.text: A new era has arrived, Mr. Bartok. People don't need soft, pathetic lullabies anymore.
say:34:1064501024:1.source_cn: 新的时代已经来了，巴托克先生。人们不需要那些软绵绵的催眠曲。

say:35:1064501025:1.text: Join us, play what we ask, and the position of concertmaster at the Bonn City Orchestra is yours. This is our final offer.
say:35:1064501025:1.source_cn: 只要你加入黑金，按要求演奏，波恩城乐团首席的位子就是你...

say:36:1064501026:1.text:
I refuse.
Even if there's only one person left in the audience, I'll keep playing my own music.
say:36:1064501026:1.source_cn: 不，我拒绝。\n哪怕只剩一名听众，我也会坚持自己的旋律。

say:37:1064501027:1.text: What a shame. I really hoped we could settle this peacefully.
say:37:1064501027:1.source_cn: 真遗憾。我原本希望大家能体面一点。

say:39:1064501028:1.text: Lira waves his hand, and the thugs behind him swarm forward, surrounding Bartok as they begin beating him up.
say:39:1064501028:1.source_cn: 利拉挥了挥手，他身后的打手蜂拥而上，将巴托克团团围住，...

say:40:1064501029:1.text: Through his fading vision, the last thing Bartok sees is the sheet music with Sylphira's melodies scattering across the floor.
say:40:1064501029:1.source_cn: 模糊的视线中，巴托克看到的最后一个画面，是记载着奥菲戈...

say:2:1064502003:1.text: Distant voices echo in Bartok's ears, followed by a piercing ring, like a needle thrust deep into Bartok's skull.
say:2:1064502003:1.source_cn: 忽远忽近的声音在耳边回荡，随后是尖锐的嗡鸣，钢针一般猛...

say:3:1064502004:0.text: Bartok reflexively tries to cover his ears, but loses his balance and falls off the cot. The pain jolts him awake.
say:3:1064502004:0.source_cn: 巴托克下意识想要抬手捂住双耳，身体却失去了平衡，从床板...

say:6:1064502006:0.text:
A rough hand pulls Bartok to his feet.
He blinks a few times before recognizing the man: Tich, the old theater doorman.
say:6:1064502006:0.source_cn: 一只粗糙的大手将巴托克从地上扶起。\n巴托克眨了眨眼睛...

say:9:1064502008:1.text: Where am I? What happened to me? Ugh... my head...
say:9:1064502008:1.source_cn: 蒂奇？！这、这是哪里……我这是怎么了？嘶……好疼……

say:10:1064502009:1.text: Tich's mouth moves, but his voice sounds distant, impossible to make out.
say:10:1064502009:1.source_cn: 蒂奇的嘴一张一合，声音像从远方传来，断成一节一节，怎么...

say:11:1064502010:1.text: Tich leans closer to Bartok's ear and raises his voice.
say:11:1064502010:1.source_cn: 蒂奇似乎看出了巴托克的窘迫，凑到他耳边，提高了音量。

say:12:1064502011:1.text: It's me! Tich! This is my storeroom! Can you hear me? I said you, are, safe!
say:12:1064502011:1.source_cn: 是我！蒂奇！这里是我的仓库！——听得见吗？我说，你——...

say:13:1064502012:1.text: Your ears were bleeding pretty badly. I cleaned you up and put some salve on them.
say:13:1064502012:1.source_cn: 你那天耳朵流了好多血，我给你洗了洗伤口，又上了些药。

say:14:1064502013:1.text: But there was so much commotion outside these past few days, and you didn't even flinch. I got a doctor to look at you. He said your injuries were serious...
say:14:1064502013:1.source_cn: 可这几天外头动静那么大，你都一点反应也没有。我找了个医...

say:15:1064502014:1.text: What do you mean? How long til I fully recover?
say:15:1064502014:1.source_cn: 很严重？要多久才能恢复？！

say:16:1064502015:1.text: The doctor said it might take a long time, or...
say:16:1064502015:1.source_cn: 医生说可能很久都好不了，也可能……嗯……

say:17:1064502016:1.text: Maybe... you'll only ever hear muffled noises for the rest of your life.
say:17:1064502016:1.source_cn: 可能……这辈子都只能听见些模模糊糊的动静。

say:20:1064502019:1.text: Tich's mouth moves again, seemingly saying something, but his voice is so quiet that Bartok can't catch a single word.
say:20:1064502019:1.source_cn: 蒂奇的嘴巴一张一合，似乎在说着什么，但他的声音很小，巴...

say:21:1064502020:1.text: I can't hear... I can't hear anything anymore...

say:22:1064502021:1.text: The piano, the flute, the drums, the melodies... That was my entire life! How am I supposed to live in silence?!
say:22:1064502021:1.source_cn: 琴声、笛声、鼓点……旋律与音阶……那是我活着的全部意义...

say:23:1064502022:1.text: I spent half my life chasing Lady Sylphira's melodies, and now... I'll never have the chance again!
say:23:1064502022:1.source_cn: 我穷尽半生，去追寻奥菲戈斯女士的旋律，如今……再也没有...

say:24:1064502023:1.text: As Bartok sinks into despair, a large hand rests firmly on his shoulder.
say:24:1064502023:1.source_cn: 正当巴托克沉浸于悲伤和悔恨之中，一只大手落在他的肩上。

say:25:1064502024:1.text: Don't you give up, Mr. Bartok! Whatever happens from here on out, I'll always be your most loyal listener.
say:25:1064502024:1.source_cn: 巴托克先生，千万别丧气！不管以后怎么样，我都是你最忠实...

say:26:1064502025:1.text: So many musicians have passed through the Bonn Grand Theater, but your music is the only thing that makes me feel calm and at ease. It's nothing like the grotesque tunes those Syndicate lot play!
say:26:1064502025:1.source_cn: 波恩大剧院来来往往这么多音乐家，只有你演奏的曲子最让我...

say:27:1064502026:1.text: Besides... They're hosting a massive concert in the square in a few days. If you ask me, they're trying to drive the whole city mad!
say:27:1064502026:1.source_cn: 而且我听说……黑金那帮人过几天要在广场办一场演奏会！依...

say:28:1064502027:1.text: Mr. Bartok, you've got to do something! We can't let those bastards get away with this!
say:28:1064502027:1.source_cn: 巴托克先生，你得做点什么！不能让这群混蛋得逞啊！

say:29:1064502028:1.text: They... they actually mean to use music to corrupt the people!
say:29:1064502028:1.source_cn: 黑金……他们竟然……还想利用音乐蛊惑民众！

say:30:1064502029:1.text:
... You're right, Tich.
I can't simply lie here and accept defeat.
say:30:1064502029:1.source_cn: ……你、你说得对，蒂奇。\n我不能就这样倒下。

say:31:1064502030:1.text: The square, on the day of the concert...

say:32:1064502031:1.text: If I can play Lady Sylphira's melody while the crowd is gathered, maybe I can awaken the manipulated citizens.
say:32:1064502031:1.source_cn: 要是，趁着民众聚集的机会，演奏奥菲戈斯女士的旋律，说不...

say:33:1064502032:1.text: Tich grins and carefully retrieves Bartok's lute from the corner.
say:33:1064502032:1.source_cn: 蒂奇露出了粗犷的笑容，他小心翼翼地从墙角拿出巴托克的鲁特琴。

say:34:1064502033:1.text: Now that's more like it! Here, I managed to get your lute and sheet music back while those thugs weren't looking. See if they're still in working order.
say:34:1064502033:1.source_cn: 这才像话！喏，趁那帮家伙没注意，我给你的琴和乐谱拿回来...

say:35:1064502034:1.text: I'd better get back to the theater. If I'm gone too long, they'll get suspicious. I can't let them find out you're here.
say:35:1064502034:1.source_cn: 好了，我得先回剧院了，出来得太久会惹黑金那帮人怀疑。我...

say:36:1064502035:1.text: Mr. Bartok, your final curtain hasn't come yet!
say:36:1064502035:1.source_cn: 巴托克先生，你还没到谢幕的时候呢！

say:39:1064502037:0.text: Tich gently closes the door, leaving the storeroom in silence once more.
say:39:1064502037:0.source_cn: 蒂奇将门轻轻合上，仓库重归寂静。

say:40:1064502038:0.text: Bartok runs his fingers over the familiar lute. Taking a deep breath, he begins to play Sylphira's melody, a piece he knows by heart.
say:40:1064502038:0.source_cn: 巴托克抚过熟悉的鲁特琴，深呼吸后，开始演奏他熟稔于心的...

say:41:1064502039:1.text: But as the melody begins, the rhythm falls into disarray, distorted by his damaged hearing.
say:41:1064502039:1.source_cn: 可旋律响起，本该流畅连贯的节拍，因他残缺的听觉而十分混乱。

say:43:1064502041:1.text: Bartok starts over again and again. Yet no matter how many times he tries, the harmony that once captivated his audience fails to return.
say:43:1064502041:1.source_cn: 巴托克一遍遍重来，可无论试多少次，那份曾让听众屏息的和...

say:44:1064502042:1.text: Exhausted, Bartok eventually loses the strength to lift his arms.
say:44:1064502042:1.source_cn: 不知过了多久，力竭的巴托克已无法抬起胳膊，他伏在乐谱上...

say:45:1064502043:1.text: He collapses over his sheet music, his breathing slowly steadying, falling into a deep sleep.
say:45:1064502043:1.source_cn: 在无边的疲惫与挥之不去的耳鸣中，巴托克沉沉睡去……

say:4:1064503002:0.text: Bartok, don't come any closer! Run!

say:12:1064503005:1.text: Just before the Hypofiend reaches young Bartok—
say:12:1064503005:1.source_cn: 魔物追上小巴托克的前一刻——

say:13:1064503006:1.text: Golden musical notes weave through the flames of war, forming beams of light that bind the Hypofiend in place.
say:13:1064503006:1.source_cn: 肉眼可见的金色乐符在战火中交织穿梭，化作流光，将魔物牢...

say:14:1064503007:1.text: An elegant figure appears. Her steps are as precise as a metronome, and when she folds her wings, the scent of blossoms fills the air.
say:14:1064503007:1.source_cn: 一道优雅的身影现身，她的步履如节拍器一般精准，羽翼收束...

say:16:1064503008:0.text:
How noisy.
Let's put a rest to this.
say:16:1064503008:0.source_cn: 聒噪。\n就在此，划下休止符！

say:17:1064503009:0.text: Sylphira drives her tuning fork into the Hypofiend's chest. Amid a fiery rhapsody, the Hypofiend fades away.
say:17:1064503009:0.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯将音叉刺入魔物胸膛，在激昂的狂想曲中，魔物渐渐消散。

say:18:1064503010:0.text: She moves her tuning fork once more, turning the notes into a bright, pure radiance. A soothing requiem spreads outward, enveloping the civilians trapped in grief and despair.
say:18:1064503010:0.source_cn: 她继续舞动音叉，音符化作皎白，伴随舒缓的安魂曲旋律，一...

say:19:1064503011:1.text: Sylphira then gently smooths the feathers at her shoulder, making sure every one is perfectly in place.
say:19:1064503011:1.source_cn: 随后，奥菲戈斯轻轻整理肩侧的羽毛，确认每一根都归于应处...

say:22:1064503012:0.text: Bartok... it's alright now... it's alright.

say:23:1064503013:0.text: Mama, I hear some beautiful music...
say:23:1064503013:0.source_cn: 妈妈，我好像听到了动听的音乐声……

say:24:1064503014:0.source_cn: 我、我好像没有那么害怕了……！

say:25:1064503015:0.text: That music... Could it be Lady Sylphira? Has the legendary Celestial of music descended?!
say:25:1064503015:0.source_cn: 乐曲声……难道、难道是奥菲戈斯大人？传说中的音律半神降...

say:26:1064503016:1.text: Sylphira gives a slight nod as if taking a final bow.
say:26:1064503016:1.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯没有否认，微微颔首，像是为这场演出谢幕。

say:27:1064503017:0.text: Oh my... the legends were true.

say:28:1064503018:0.text: Lady Sylphira, now that you are here, does this mean the war will end soon?
say:28:1064503018:0.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯大人，您降临了，战争是不是很快就能平息了？

say:29:1064503019:0.text: A Celestial's power can indeed silence discord in this world.
say:29:1064503019:0.source_cn: 半神的力量，的确能抹去这世间不协之声。

say:30:1064503020:0.text: But once I depart, the unrest suppressed by divine power will eventually return.
say:30:1064503020:0.source_cn: 可我一旦离开，受神力镇压的躁动，终会卷土重来。

say:31:1064503021:1.text: Mortals have music of their own. Whether it degrades into mere noise or rises into true harmony is a choice they must make for themselves.
say:31:1064503021:1.source_cn: 凡人自有其乐音，是任由它沦为噪音，还是归于和谐，需要自...

say:32:1064503022:0.text: Sylphira spreads her wings and takes flight, leaving the subtle fragrance of flowers lingering in the air.
say:32:1064503022:0.source_cn: 随后，奥菲戈斯振翅而起，花木清香糅杂在余韵中，久久不散。

say:35:1064503023:0.text: Young Bartok watches her disappear into the distance. The solemn, pure melody continues to echo in his mind, as if setting a new tempo for a broken world.
say:35:1064503023:0.source_cn: 少年巴托克望着远去的身影，庄严、纯净的旋律仍在他脑海中...

say:36:1064503024:0.text: Mama, I think I've found my calling.
say:36:1064503024:0.source_cn: 妈妈，我好像找到了方向——

say:37:1064503025:0.text: I want to become a musician. I want to travel far and wide, and play the melody I just heard for everyone!
say:37:1064503025:0.source_cn: 我想成为一名音乐家，去很多很多地方，为许许多多的人，奏...

narration:40:1064503027:1.source_cn: 音乐……奥菲、奥菲戈斯……神啊……

say:41:1064503028:0.text: Bartok opens his eyes. The storeroom is still dark, and the ringing in his ears hasn't gone away. He rubs his temples, trying to focus.
say:41:1064503028:0.source_cn: 巴托克睁眼，仓库内仍旧昏暗，耳中的嗡鸣没有消失。他揉了...

say:42:1064503029:1.text: He suddenly notices that several lines of unfamiliar, elegant handwriting have appeared on the sheet music before him.
say:42:1064503029:1.source_cn: 眼前散落的乐谱上，不知何时多了几行字迹清隽的陌生批注——

say:44:1064503031:1.text: "Bar 23—Legato, draw the bow through to the end."
say:44:1064503031:1.source_cn: “第二十三小节——此处的连奏，一弓到底”

say:47:1064503033:1.text: <shk>This is Lady Sylphira's presence! She was here!</shk>
say:47:1064503033:1.source_cn: <shk>这是——奥菲戈斯女士的气息！她来过！</shk>

say:49:1064503034:1.text: Bartok rushes back to his instrument and begins practicing again, following the annotations.
say:49:1064503034:1.source_cn: 巴托克急忙回到乐器前，按照几行批注，又一次开始排演。

say:50:1064503035:1.text: He closes his eyes. Though the ringing in his ears hasn't faded, he can still feel the strings vibrate against his fingers and the steady rhythm beneath his feet.
say:50:1064503035:1.source_cn: 他闭上眼，耳中浑浊的嗡鸣并未消散。可琴弦在细微颤动，脚...

say:51:1064503036:1.text: The scattered melodies gradually stitch together into a steady rhythm, like lines of music lighting up once more in the darkness.
say:51:1064503036:1.source_cn: 那些散乱的旋律渐渐连成节拍，如同黑暗中重新亮起的谱线。

say:52:1064503037:1.text: Bartok once again senses a solemn and extraordinary harmony.
say:52:1064503037:1.source_cn: 在听觉的废墟里，巴托克再一次感知到庄严、稳定、非凡的和谐。

say:54:1064503038:1.text: Losing my hearing doesn't mean music has abandoned me.
say:54:1064503038:1.source_cn: 原来失去听觉，并不意味着音乐已经离我而去……

say:55:1064503039:1.text: Lady Sylphira, I will follow your guidance and keep playing.
say:55:1064503039:1.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯女士，我会循着您的指引，演奏下去。

say:1:1064504001:0.text: The Syndicate Orchestra's stage stands at the center of the square. Dozens of musicians frantically play, their war drums and brass instruments weaving ominous tunes.
say:1:1064504001:0.source_cn: 黑金乐团的舞台矗立在广场中央，数十名乐手奋力演奏，战鼓...

say:2:1064504002:0.text: A dense crowd fills the square. Their eyes are bloodshot, their fists raised as they lose their minds to the <style="highlight">dark magic</style> infused within the sound.
say:2:1064504002:0.source_cn: 台下聚集着黑压压的人流，他们双眼发红，挥舞着拳头，因带...

say:5:1064504003:0.text: So loud... so loud... Heh... hehehe... Make it louder...
say:5:1064504003:0.source_cn: 好吵……好吵……嘻嘻……嘻嘻嘻……响、再响一些……

say:6:1064504004:0.text: Burn it... burn it all... I'm burning up... Burn everything!
say:6:1064504004:0.source_cn: 烧掉……烧掉……我的身体好烫……全部烧掉！

say:9:1064504005:0.text: Yes, that's it! Throw away every last shred of reason!
say:9:1064504005:0.source_cn: 很好，很好！就是这样，把你们的理智通通抛掉！

say:10:1064504006:0.text: Let the power of the abyss seep into your flesh! When the final note falls, you'll all transform into offerings to the abyss!
say:10:1064504006:0.source_cn: 让深渊的魔力浸透你们的血肉！等最后一个音符落下，你们都...

narration:13:1064504008:1.text: Meanwhile, on the other side of the square...
narration:13:1064504008:1.source_cn: 与此同时，广场另一侧角落

say:16:1064504009:0.text: This music... it's unbearable! Even an old man like me with bad hearing is getting a headache!
say:16:1064504009:0.source_cn: 这、这音乐……太嘈杂了！连我这种耳背的老家伙都觉得头疼！

say:17:1064504010:0.text: Mr. Bartok, you have to do something!
say:17:1064504010:0.source_cn: 巴托克先生，你得想想办法！

say:18:1064504011:0.text: I know. Years ago, in a moment of despair just like this, Lady Sylphira saved my life.
say:18:1064504011:0.source_cn: 我知道……很多年前，也是这样绝望的时刻，是奥菲戈斯女士...

say:19:1064504012:0.text: Even if I can never hear again... I have to play her melody!
say:19:1064504012:0.source_cn: 现在，即使我再也听不见……也要奏响她的旋律！

say:21:1064504013:0.text: The lute begins to play. But because Bartok can't hear the melody clearly, the tempo doesn't follow its proper speed.
say:21:1064504013:0.source_cn: 琴声响起。然而，因为巴托克听不清旋律，节拍却偏离了应有...

say:22:1064504014:1.text: He takes a deep breath, following the annotations on the sheet music. Feeling the vibrations at his fingertips, he slowly recovers the original rhythm.
say:22:1064504014:1.source_cn: 他猛然深吸一口气，按照乐谱上的批注，感受着指尖的震动，...

say:23:1064504015:1.text: The broken rhythm finds its way back together. An elegant, sacred melody rings out, echoing over the city of Bonn.
say:23:1064504015:1.source_cn: 断裂的节拍重新接续，优雅神圣的乐曲悠扬而出，笼罩在波恩...

say:24:1064504016:0.text: Drawn by the beautiful melody, many citizens gather around Bartok.
say:24:1064504016:0.source_cn: 无数民众被这动听的旋律所吸引，聚集到了巴托克身前。

say:25:1064504017:0.text: Meanwhile, Lira flies into a rage up on the stage.
say:25:1064504017:0.source_cn: 与此同时，舞台上的利拉气急败坏。

say:29:1064504018:0.text: You're still alive?! You think you can ruin the Syndicate's plans?!
say:29:1064504018:0.source_cn: 巴托克……你居然还没死！还想破坏黑金的大计？！

say:30:1064504019:0.text: Fine! Then let the roar of Hypofiends drown out your little tune once and for all!
say:30:1064504019:0.source_cn: 既然这样，那就让魔物的怒吼，彻底盖过你的旋律吧！

say:31:1064504020:1.text: Lira strikes the war drums furiously. The ground cracks beneath the violent music, and a gigantic Hypofiend emerges from the fissure, roaring and charging at Bartok.
say:31:1064504020:1.source_cn: 利拉猛捶战鼓，狂暴的乐声撕裂空气，地面随之龟裂，一只巨...

say:37:1064504024:0.text: Don't... don't worry about me! Keep... ugh...

say:39:1064504025:1.text: The monster steps over Tich, lunging brutally toward Bartok—
say:39:1064504025:1.source_cn: 魔物踏过蒂奇，狠狠冲向巴托克——

say:41:1064504026:0.text: That is quite enough of this discordant noise.

say:42:1064504027:1.text: Sylphira calmly moves to Bartok's side, her steps falling precisely on the beat. Under the influence of the music that accompanies her, the Hypofiend freezes in place.
say:42:1064504027:1.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯从容地走到巴托克身旁，一步一拍，在伴随她而来的...

say:44:1064504029:0.text: I told you once that mortals must choose the voice of harmony for themselves. Today, I have heard your answer.
say:44:1064504029:0.source_cn: 我曾说过，凡人必须自己选择和谐之声。如今，我听到了你们...

say:45:1064504030:0.text: Do not falter. Focus on your music.

say:48:1064504032:0.text:
Sylphira lifts her tuning fork and gives it a gentle strike, marking a precise tempo for the performance.
Bartok plucks the strings, following Sylphira's melody.
say:48:1064504032:0.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯举起音叉，轻轻一振，为演奏划下精准的节拍。\n...

say:49:1064504033:0.text: A waltz begins. The 3/4 rhythm seems to draw the stunned Hypofiend along with an invisible melody. It slowly fades away as it stumbles through clumsy dance steps.
say:49:1064504033:0.source_cn: 圆舞曲响起——3/4拍的节奏轻快而优雅，怔住的魔物仿佛...

say:50:1064504034:0.text: As the citizens regain their senses, they begin dancing to the music. Even the Syndicate members drop their weapons and find themselves swaying along.
say:50:1064504034:0.source_cn: 清醒后的民众纷纷随乐声共舞华尔兹，就连黑金成员们也纷纷...

say:53:1064504035:0.text: I think I see a beautiful river...
say:53:1064504035:0.source_cn: 我好像看到了一条蓝色的河流……

say:54:1064504036:0.text: It's beautiful... This is what true music is.

say:57:1064504037:0.text: You idiots! What are you doing?!

say:58:1064504038:0.text: All of you are useless! In that case, let's bring the abyssal symphony to its climax early!
say:58:1064504038:0.source_cn: 废物，都是废物！既然这样，就让深渊的乐章提前进入高潮吧！

say:59:1064504039:1.text: Lira frantically pounds the war drums. The ground shakes as several giant Hypofiends emerge.
say:59:1064504039:1.source_cn: 利拉以更疯狂的力量捶打起战鼓，地面剧烈震颤，数只比先前...

say:65:1064504041:0.text: Making noise before a performance has concluded is terribly impolite.
say:65:1064504041:0.source_cn: 在演奏尚未结束时制造噪音，可是相当失礼的行为。

say:66:1064504042:0.text: Such dissonant noise requires a proper piece of music to bring it to an end!
say:66:1064504042:0.source_cn: 这般不谐的杂音，需要一支乐曲，来为其作结——！

say:67:1064504043:1.text: Sylphira raises her tuning fork. The graceful waltz suddenly surges into a passionate rhapsody. As the music swells, golden notes pour forth.
say:67:1064504043:1.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯抬起音叉，圆舞曲的悠扬骤变为激昂的狂想，伴随渐...

say:70:1064504045:0.text: Accompanied by layers of musical notes, the Hypofiends completely shatter and dissolve into dust.
say:70:1064504045:0.source_cn: 伴随着层层渐强的金色音符，魔物们尽数崩解、消散。

say:71:1064504046:0.text: As the final powerful note rings out, Sylphira changes the melody. A soaring aria flows through the city like a gentle river, washing over all of Bonn.
say:71:1064504046:0.source_cn: 最后一道强音落下，奥菲戈斯再度变奏——咏叹调旋律悠扬，...

say:72:1064504047:0.text: Bartok begins to hum along, and more and more voices join in naturally, merging with Sylphira's playing to form a magnificent concerto.
say:72:1064504047:0.source_cn: 巴托克不自觉地喃喃轻和，越来越多的声音自发加入，与奥菲...

say:73:1064504048:0.text: As the final note slowly fades away, Sylphira lowers her tuning fork and bows to the audience.
say:73:1064504048:0.source_cn: 当最后一个音符缓缓消散，在民众的欢呼声中，奥菲戈斯收起...

say:3:1064505001:0.text: Lady Sylphira, it truly is you... I never dreamed I would see you again.
say:3:1064505001:0.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯女士，真的是您……我从没想过还能再见到您……

say:4:1064505002:0.text: If... if you'll allow me, I'd like to dedicate the music of the rest of my life to you, until the day I can no longer pluck a single string!
say:4:1064505002:0.source_cn: 若、若您同意，请允许我将余生的乐声献给您，直到我无力拨...

say:5:1064505003:0.text: Mr. Bartok, your skill as a musician is already enough to move the hearts of others.
say:5:1064505003:0.source_cn: 巴托克先生，你的演奏技艺，已足以令人动容。

say:6:1064505004:0.text: But to preserve the voice of harmony while surrounded by injury, fear, and chaos—that is far more precious than flawless technique.
say:6:1064505004:0.source_cn: 但在深陷伤病、恐惧与失序的时刻，仍能守住和谐之声，这比...

say:7:1064505005:0.text: There are still many mortals on this land trapped in discord. They need your melodies far more than I do.
say:7:1064505005:0.source_cn: 这片大地，仍有诸多受困于杂音的凡人，相比于我，他们更需...

say:8:1064505006:0.text: Sylphira carefully preens her feathers, ensuring that missing one will not disrupt her neat appearance. She then draws a single feather from her golden crest and hands it to Bartok.
say:8:1064505006:0.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯仔细梳理羽毛，确认少去一支仍不显凌乱后，从金色...

say:9:1064505007:0.text: Every feather has its rightful place. And this one belongs with you.
say:9:1064505007:0.source_cn: 每根羽毛，都有它应在的位置，而这一支，理应交由你。

say:11:1064505008:0.text: Folding her wings, Sylphira slowly walks down the peaceful street.
say:11:1064505008:0.source_cn: 随后，奥菲戈斯收拢羽翼，沿着复归宁静的街道缓步离去。

narration:13:1064505009:0.text: Several years later, inside the Bonn Grand Theater...
narration:13:1064505009:0.source_cn: 数年后，波恩城大剧院内

say:17:1064505011:0.text: Seeing Bartok still absorbed in his rehearsal, Tich walks over and raises his voice.
say:17:1064505011:0.source_cn: 见巴托克仍在专注地排演着乐曲，蒂奇走到巴托克身侧，提高...

say:20:1064505013:0.text: It's the middle of the night. If you keep pushing yourself like this, one of these days, humanity's going to lose its finest musician!
say:20:1064505013:0.source_cn: 这都后半夜了！再这么熬下去，保不齐哪天人类可要失去他们...

say:21:1064505014:0.text: Inspiration doesn't just show up on command. Go to bed, Mr. Bartok!
say:21:1064505014:0.source_cn: 灵感这东西，又不是说来就来的。快去睡吧，巴托克先生！

say:22:1064505015:0.text: ... Alright, alright. I'll rest in a moment.

say:23:1064505016:0.text: Oh, please. You say that every time, and you never mean it.
say:23:1064505016:0.source_cn: 哎呀，每次都说一会儿，每次都不作数。

say:24:1064505017:0.text: I'm definitely not falling for that again!
say:24:1064505017:0.source_cn: 你们这些音乐家，嘴比大门还会吱呀。

say:25:1064505018:0.text: Heh. Fine, I'll go rest now.

say:27:1064505019:0.text: Bartok puts away his instrument and takes a golden feather from the case. Though years have passed, it still gleams as brightly as new.
say:27:1064505019:0.source_cn: 巴托克收纳好乐器，从琴匣中取出一支金色的羽毛，多年过去...

say:28:1064505020:0.text: He places the feather onto his unfinished sheet music, then blows out the candle and leaves the theater.
say:28:1064505020:0.source_cn: 巴托克将羽毛一丝不苟地放在未完成的乐谱上，随后吹灭蜡烛...

say:30:1064505022:0.text: Bartok enters the theater and opens his sheet music. Beside the feather, several neat lines of annotations have appeared.
say:30:1064505022:0.source_cn: 巴托克走入剧院，翻开乐谱——羽毛一旁，多出了几行清隽的批注。

say:31:1064505023:0.text: Following the annotations, Bartok begins to play once more...
say:31:1064505023:0.source_cn: 依照批注，巴托克再一次开始演奏……

say:32:1064505024:1.text: melody that had troubled him for days suddenly flows freely. The passages that once felt stilted fall back into harmonious rhythm, as though guided by divine inspiration.
say:32:1064505024:1.source_cn: 那段困扰他多日的旋律豁然流动，原本滞涩的段落，有如神启...

say:35:1064505026:1.text: You've been listening to my music all along, haven't you?
say:35:1064505026:1.source_cn: 您一定，一直在聆听我的演奏。
